founder_capture.visible_error: Unavailable: app_info() must be called from the UI thread

root_cause: The V2 companion queued live Orca context capture to its persistent Script worker even though the pinned host permits app_info() only from the UI thread and documents dock-panel on_message callbacks as UI-thread callbacks.
bounded_disposition: Keep the official edited-preset transaction on the persistent Script worker, move only read-only live slot/context capture to the native UI callback, add a regression test for callback-thread ownership, and rerun the current Windows gate.
